title: First Delivery Owner Lane Acceptance
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the first delivery round Work path, owner repository, active role, Checklist target, or Evidence target before accepting owner-lane handoffs.

The Backend or Editor WORK result lacks lane ID, Work Type, owner repository, Context Acknowledgement, terminal status, retrievable locator, exact commit, files changed, behavior changed, tests run, risks, unknowns, or PR Summary Draft.
PLAN accepts either owner lane without automatic WORK-to-PLAN return evidence and fresh owner-repository verification from the merged main branch.

The Backend or Editor lane changes Core semantics, cross-repository contracts, Project Control truth, map truth, production credential handling, renderer execution, PDF bytes, or end-to-end integration without an accepted Contract Change Request.
The accepted owner lanes are promoted to end-to-end delivery, product readiness, release readiness, frontend readiness, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth before lane-integration-evidence exists.

summary: Done: PLAN received Backend and Editor owner-lane handoffs through the active WORK-to-PLAN return channel, processed the Backend revision path before final PASS, accepted lane-backend-gateway-database and lane-editor-structure-publish at their merged main commits, recorded bounded Project Control evidence, and kept lane-integration-evidence held until a later integration proof exists.
